commits.author: ccason
commits.subject: Add a test-delta pane: what the diff shows about the tests
commits.body:
Coverage says a test ran a line and mutation says a test would catch it
breaking. This pane answers the third question the diff alone can settle: did
the tests move with the code. Three info findings, no config and no test runs.

- source-without-test: a Go package whose source changed with no test in it
  changed. Anchored on the package, not a gate; an existing test may cover it.
- test-skip-added: a t.Skip, .skip, or focus (.only, fit) on a line the change
  adds to a test file, on the line so the drawer shows it.
- assertions-removed: a test file that ends with fewer assertion-like lines than
  it started, netted so a move or rename does not read as a loss.

New CategoryTests, pane registered in run.go. Detectors and the package logic
are unit-tested; an end-to-end run confirms all three fire on a real diff.
